text:
Sam: quick q — can we slip a tiny PR (#18944) into tonight's rolling release before the nightly blackout? only touches a feature-flag check, low risk. CI shows queued right now.
Maya: what's the CI ETA? which lanes are queued?
Sam: mac, linux, integration. mac is the slow one (queue depth 6).
Kevin: if mac is the blocker we can skip mac for a fast-path if tests are green on linux+integration then do a canary in prod. but we'll need a reviewer approve for the bypass.
Jordan: I can give a quick review now — ping me when linux/integration pass.
CI-bot: PR #18944: linux/amber - queued (2 runners), integration/amber - running (12m), mac/amber - queued (6 runners).
Maya: integration is flaking sometimes, what's the failure mode?
Sam: spurious timeout in long-poll test. I added a retry and reduced the sleep. local runs clean.
Kevin: OK, plan: wait for linux+integration green, Jordan to approve, then ReleaseBot to uplift to canary skipping mac lane. If canary looks good for 30m, full rollout post-blackout.
Jordan: doing review now. small nit on log message, will approve after patch.
Sam: pushed fix for nit and rebased onto main (`git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main`).
CI-bot: PR #18944: integration/amber - passed, linux/amber - passed, mac/amber - queued.
Jordan: approved.
ReleaseBot: uplift request accepted: canary rollout scheduled to bypass mac lane. blackout window starts 7012346000.
Maya: thanks — I'll watch canary and post status. If anything suspicious, we'll abort and requeue for next window.
Sam: appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
